result.changelog:
All 9 entries kept. Two were retitled: "Federation Police and Army" is now "Federation Police and military command", and "Bounty hunters and the Federation" is now "Federation contracts and bounty hunters". Word counts run 238-455; the overview is the only entry over 404.

Errors fixed:
- The Federation Force Metroid egg is no longer placed between SR388 and Zebes. It is now dated only as after the Bermuda System incident, which matches the federation-force domain.
- The Super Metroid "emergency directive" is gone. A Ceres distress signal sent Samus after Ridley.
- Sylux is now a Federation field captain and the sole survivor of his platoon, per Prime 4: Beyond on Wikipedia. "Deserted" was dropped.
- The Aurora Unit 217 order is corrected: the vaccine came first, then Ghor cut the link and Samus repaired it.

Unverified claims removed or softened:
- Samus "stationed at HQ"; G.F.S. Aegis; the "don't know what they got themselves into" trooper line and the claim that troopers covered her retreat.
- The Aurora Units' "20 years" research origin, "core worlds" and "tactical and stellar research data".
- "Pirate origin" of the Aurora virus and the Valhalla raid being part of Dane's briefing.
- The Federation choosing to destroy the Bottle Ship; "refitted"; the Bottle Ship's E.M.M.I. build timing; "recovered data confirmed Metroids".
- The manga claim that hunters are "extravagantly expensive"; 217 "discovering Phaaze"; "saved space goes to weapons".
- Daiban cut down to: capital planet, manga-only, unofficial transliteration, council meets there, Keaton as Chairman.

Nits applied: "take" rather than "retake" Zebes; the Jigrad wording and the "piece of baggage" remark; the Army branch is now hedged; Norion is no longer credited to Samus alone; the Corruption ending; "Leviathan battleship" used consistently; Delano 7, the Valhalla crew and the Anhur class; Demolition Troopers; the eight-day timing; Sector Zero as "a recreation of Tourian" (from Wikipedia).

Missing material added:
- Bryyo as a Federation protectorate and its Fuel Gel economy.
- The Elysian information-for-supplies arrangement and the Treaty of Elysia date.
- Ian Malkovich's death.
- The Federation Force and the Valhalla Marine losses.
- The Olympus as the first capital ship built around an Aurora Unit, and the Valhalla's ten Energy Cells.
- MB's reprogramming and the Space Pirate-based special-forces aim.
- Why the Hunters contract was covert, and that Samus had to defeat the three corrupted hunters.
- The Chairman's orders in Other M.
- 217's male voice and 313's extraction log line.

Keys:
- Generic keys removed: trooper, troopers, contract, contracted, bounty, headquarters, extermination, exterminate, cover-up, secret program, Aurora.
- Added class names, Enkidu, Naval Base Demeter, AU 486, Demolition Trooper and PED Marines.
- Some keys were moved off these entries to avoid double-firing: Kreatz, Mauk, Jigrad and Chief Hardy go to the manga and samus-bio entries; Exeter, Herakles and Squad Bravo to Prime 2; bare Olympus, Valhalla and Tyr to Prime 3 and Prime 2; singular "bounty hunter" to samus-bio and tech.
- Lines claiming what "canon never shows" and invented motives were removed.
result.unresolved:
- Daiban and Keaton rest only on search snippets from Wikitroid and BreezeWiki. Metroid Wiki has no page for either, and they are labeled "per the manga". The two sources in that entry are marked "(search snippet only)".
- The "Galactic Federation Army" branch name is hedged as "other official accounts". The verify report says this wording comes from PAL trophy text, while samus-bio cites an official profile.
- Three trooper scene details were kept on the verify pass's acceptance but not re-fetched this round: the post-Zebes quarantine officer, "humans predominate on Norion", and Aurora Unit 313 as "one of the first units".
- The Diffusion Missile withholding quote could not be found on Metroid Wiki and was not added.
- WebSearch was used once; everything else was checked with WebFetch.
